ana: Quick recap from vendor sync 1: H100 GA still tentatively 2024-08-14, H200 firmware rollback possibility, MI300 APAC cert needs signature, Gaudi driver v2 ABI change confirmed. Need single timeline for marketplace + SI + PR.
bryce: Marketplace constraint reminder: we require final image sha256 + driver id 10 calendar days before public listing. For co-announcement marketing needs 10 business days.
mira: SI note: Gaudi ABI change means integrators must rebuild. Recommend a 5-day dry-run window once RC published to avoid last-minute failures.
devon: Perf telemetry: if microcode for H100 causes >3% token jitter on long contexts we should gate public perf claims. Repro snippet: `./bench --model=h100-rtx --seq=4096 --iter=200`.
partner-bot: Vendor feed: Gaudi driver v2 RC expected 2024-07-19; H100 microcode validation ETA updated +7 days; MI300 APAC docs awaiting signatures (link: https://vendor.example/feeds/1777).
nana: (typo) ana: action items: 1) vendor GA confirm (ANA) by 2024-07-15 EOD, 2) marketplace SKU freeze plan + soft-list option (BRYCE) target 2024-07-20, 3) SI dry-run schedule (MIRA) target 2024-07-22, 4) fallback routing rules for H100 delays (DEVON)
bryce: Soft-list plan: publish partner-only pinned images on 2024-07-25 with clear note "pending vendor GA". That gives integrators time and keeps public PR on hold until final GA.
mira: SI ops: will reserve dry-run lanes 2024-07-22..2024-07-26 and provide CI jobs to auto-rebuild on RC. Need integrator lead emails now.
devon: Fallback routing example to apply if H100 not validated: `route-policy add h100_fallback -> [h200-prod, b200-q8] when microcode_unverified=true OR p99>200ms`
marketing-bot: Draft fallback blurb created in drive: "Partner early access available; public availability pending final vendor validation. See partners doc for details."
partner-bot: Reminder: marketplace image checksum policy requires `sha256` and `vendor-driver` tags.
bryce: One more ask: legal will need a vendor attestation for microcode changes if we publish performance numbers. Please loop legal early.
nana: (typo) ana: timeline (draft): - 2024-07-15: vendor GA confirm deadline - 2024-07-19: Gaudi RC expected - 2024-07-22: SI dry-run kickoff - 2024-07-25: partner-only pinned image publish - 2024-08-05: message freeze for an 2024-08-15 public announce (if GA confirmed)
mira: EU private deploys note: add +3 business days for residency checks. I'll add to gating checklist.
devon: infra note: reassign Dedicated pools to B200 for latency-sensitive workloads can be done in ~36h; flag oncall.
nana: (typo) ana: owners confirmed. I'll publish consolidated timeline doc and ping integrator leads + legal. Closing this thread; will update when vendor posts the attestation. :thumbsup:
